<subject>Catherine Storey for Meridian Compliance Committee</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues.  However, each of you agreed that a standard settlement deadline was acceptable for UK equity and debt transactions.

The best option will be to agree to settle at 4pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many trades were executed after 4pm London time.  We had three FTSE trades, and two AIM trades).  After 4pm, the systems would automatically roll new Meridian deals to the next day.  However, for those deals that do not roll after 4pm, the various risk groups would need to remember that these deals are the following day's business.  I am not sure how the procedures in our Finance team would need to be modified for the trader's position reports, as the official books would not include these late deals.  Can our Finance team run supplemental reports to ensure that the desks have accurate positions each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a settlement deadline of 4pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle Saunders, Vice President
020 7183 8754
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP
1 Paternoster Square, London EC4M 7DX

Eric - any potential problems with the deal reconciliation process?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
